summary: Show Core-reported network throughput in decimal bits per second and give VM console realtime charts a readable two-column layout. API impact: none; presentation only over existing stats responses.

guide.reason: Operators now read network throughput in decimal bits per second and disk throughput in bytes per second.

api.reason: GET /api/v1/{vms,hosts}/{id}/stats, the Controller-to-Core stats query, and Core bytes_per_second samples and results are unchanged; the Controller only converts network display labels. No client or Core contract changes.

roadmap.reason: This corrects presentation of an existing feature without changing milestone status.

state.reason: Unit formatting and chart layout persist no new state; Core retains the existing sampled history.

verification.method: Focused stats and host-list unit tests, UI typecheck and build, and the simulated Chromium console flow passed; desktop and mobile captures were inspected. No physical Core or forge run was performed.
